message:
fix(mp2): reject factor weights from a different orbital population

Bind factorized weight dimensions to the enclosing Lagrangian/reference before conventional or RI contraction and lookup. The new conventional native gate and two RI mismatch regressions fail on the former source. The repaired native MP2 gradient contract suite and 14 RI memory/budget tests pass locally. No numerical formula or valid-input resource limit is changed.
